findings.evidence: "This workspace holds 5 projects, synced last week." with a list of only 4 project names
findings.violation: The introductory text states 5 projects but only 4 are listed, creating a mismatch between stated and shown content
findings.fix: Either update the text to "4 projects" or add the missing 5th project name to the list

findings.violation: The button has no visible text content, only an aria-label, making its purpose unclear for sighted users
findings.fix: Add visible text content such as "Duplicate" or replace with a clear icon and text label

findings.location: Notification settings form, digest frequency select element
findings.violation: The select dropdown has no default option explicitly selected, leaving the initial selection state ambiguous
findings.fix: Add selected="selected" to one option, or prepend a placeholder option like <option value="">Select frequency</option>

findings.evidence: Button labeled "Submit" in the notification settings form while other forms use "Save"
findings.violation: Button labels are inconsistent across the form interface, using both "Submit" and "Save" for similar actions
findings.fix: Change the notification settings button to use "Save" to match the label convention used in other forms

findings.evidence: <form><label for="project-settings-name-input">Project name</label><input id="project-settings-name-input" type="text" value="Customer Migration"><button id="project-settings-save-btn" type="submit">Save</button></form>
findings.violation: The form element lacks a method attribute, defaulting to GET which exposes form data in the URL
findings.fix: Add method="POST" to the form element to use the POST method for secure data submission

findings.evidence: <form><label for="invite-member-email-input">Email address</label><input id="invite-member-email-input" type="email"><button id="invite-member-save-btn" type="submit">Save</button></form>
findings.violation: The form element lacks a method attribute, defaulting to GET which exposes email data in the URL
findings.fix: Add method="POST" to the form element to protect sensitive email data
